_comment: Persistent per-repo merge daemon. Per-transaction authority only (no single-node completion checklist): it claims one merge bead at a time, probes/lands/releases. Enforced invariant at stop: holds zero claims (bead OR sheepdog wisp). It legitimately WRITES merge_sha/pr and closes merge beads — those are its job — so they are NOT denied here; what it must never do (push code, edit content) is unenforceable at the bead layer and lives as a hard rule in its steering + a git-safety concern. deny_states blocks it from parking a work bead in a review-verdict state it has no business setting.
